en.title: Trump reveals Xi Jinping plans to visit US on September 24, preparation for US-China summit draws attention

segments.src: ## 特朗普方面透露访美安排
segments.tr: ## Trump's side reveals arrangements for US visit

segments.src: 据外媒报道，美国总统特朗普近日在公开场合表示，中国国家主席习近平计划于9月24日访问美国，双方有望举行新一轮元首会晤。截至目前，中方尚未就具体行程作出正式确认，相关安排仍处于筹备与磋商阶段，具体细节可能随双方沟通进展而调整。
segments.tr: According to foreign media reports, US President Trump recently stated in public that Chinese President Xi Jinping plans to visit the United States on September 24, and the two sides are expected to hold a new round of head-of-state talks. As of now, the Chinese side has not yet made an official confirmation regarding the specific itinerary, and related arrangements are still in the preparation and consultation stage, with specific details subject to adjustment as communication progresses between the two sides.

segments.src: 对于长期关注中美关系的观察人士而言，此次传出的访美消息延续了近期两国高层互动趋于活跃的态势，也让外界对下一阶段双边关系走向多了一个观察窗口。
segments.tr: For observers who have long followed US-China relations, the leaked news of this US visit continues the recent trend of increasingly active high-level interactions between the two countries, providing an additional window to observe the direction of bilateral relations in the next stage.

segments.src: ## 此前互动：釜山会晤与吉隆坡磋商
segments.tr: ## Previous interactions: Busan summit and Kuala Lumpur consultations

segments.src: 在此次传闻中的访美安排之前，中美双方此前已通过多个场合保持沟通。此前有报道提及两国元首曾在韩国釜山举行会晤，随后双方工作团队又在马来西亚吉隆坡进行了多轮磋商。这一系列互动被普遍视为双方为管控分歧、探索合作空间所做的持续努力，也为后续可能的高层会面奠定了沟通基础。
segments.tr: Prior to this rumored US visit arrangement, the US and Chinese sides had already maintained communication through multiple channels. Previous reports mentioned that the two heads of state had held a meeting in Busan, South Korea, after which the working teams of both sides conducted multiple rounds of consultations in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. This series of interactions is widely viewed as a continuous effort by both sides to manage differences and explore space for cooperation, laying a communication foundation for potential subsequent high-level meetings.

segments.tr: It should be noted that the specific outcomes and follow-up arrangements of the aforementioned meetings and consultations are subject to information released through official channels of the US and China. The content described in this article is merely a synthesis of public reports for readers' reference.
## Major issues of external concern

segments.src: 综合多方分析，如果此次元首会晤最终成行，以下几个领域可能成为双方讨论的重点：
segments.tr: Synthesizing multi-party analysis, if this summit ultimately takes place, the following areas may become the focus of discussion between the two sides:

segments.src: - **人工智能合作与规则**：随着人工智能技术快速发展，两国在技术标准、产业应用及潜在风险管控方面的沟通需求持续上升，相关议题近年来在多边与双边场合中出现频率明显增加。
segments.tr: - **AI cooperation and rules**: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, the communication needs between the two countries regarding technical standards, industrial applications, and potential risk management have continued to rise, and related issues have seen a significant increase in frequency in multilateral and bilateral occasions in recent years.

segments.src: - **经贸关系**：贸易与投资合作历来是中美互动的核心议题之一，双方在关税、市场准入、供应链等方面的立场沟通，将持续受到企业界与市场的密切关注。
segments.tr: - **Economic and trade relations**: Trade and investment cooperation have historically been one of the core issues of US-China interaction. The communication of positions between the two sides on tariffs, market access, supply chains, and other matters will continue to receive close attention from the business community and the market.

segments.src: - **地区安全事务**：亚太地区的稳定与安全议题也被认为是双方沟通的重要内容之一，相关讨论有助于双方增进理解、减少误判。
segments.tr: - **Regional security affairs**: Stability and security issues in the Asia-Pacific region are also considered important components of communication between the two sides, and related discussions will help both sides enhance understanding and reduce miscalculations.

segments.src: 以上议题的具体讨论内容与结果，需以会晤后双方发布的官方声明为准。
segments.tr: The specific discussion content and results of the above issues shall be subject to the official statements released by both sides after the summit.
## Subsequent signals to monitor

segments.src: 从目前公开信息看,此次访美安排仍属于筹备阶段的消息,尚待双方进一步确认与官宣。对于希望持续跟踪中美关系动向的读者而言，接下来一段时间双方外交部门的例行表态、官方媒体的相关报道，以及是否发布正式的行程公告,都将是判断此次会晤能否如期举行的重要观察点。
segments.tr: From current public information, this US visit arrangement still belongs to news in the preparation stage, awaiting further confirmation and official announcement from both sides. For readers who wish to continuously track the trends of US-China relations, the routine statements from the diplomatic departments of both sides in the coming period, relevant reports from official media, and whether official itinerary announcements are released will all be important observation points to judge whether this summit can be held as scheduled.

segments.src: 总体而言，中美作为全球最重要的双边关系之一，其高层互动向来牵动地区乃至全球市场的神经。此次传出的访美消息能否落地、会晤议题能否取得实质性进展，仍有待时间给出答案。建议关注该话题的读者以官方发布信息为准，理性看待各类媒体报道与市场猜测。
segments.tr: Overall, as one of the world's most important bilateral relationships, US-China high-level interactions always affect the nerves of regional and even global markets. Whether this leaked US visit news can materialize and whether the summit agenda can achieve substantive progress still remains to be answered by time. Readers concerned about this topic are advised to base their views on officially released information and rationally view various media reports and market speculations.

segments.src: 据外媒报道，美国总统特朗普近日在公开场合表示，中国国家主席习近平计划于9月24日访问美国，双方有望举行新一轮元首会晤。截至目前，中方尚未就具体行程作出正式确认，相关安排仍处于筹备与磋商阶段，具体细节可能随双方沟通进展而调整。
segments.tr: Selon des médias étrangers, le président américain Donald Trump a récemment déclaré publiquement que le président chinois Xi Jinping prévoyait de se rendre aux États-Unis le 24 septembre, et les deux parties devraient tenir une nouvelle série de sommets entre chefs d'État. Jusqu'à présent, la partie chinoise n'a pas encore confirmé officiellement l'itinéraire spécifique, et les arrangements pertinents sont toujours en phase de préparation et de consultation. Les détails spécifiques pourront être ajustés en fonction des progrès de la communication entre les deux parties.

segments.src: ## 特朗普方面透露访美安排
segments.tr: ## Phía Trump tiết lộ sắp xếp chuyến thăm Mỹ

segments.src: 据外媒报道，美国总统特朗普近日在公开场合表示，中国国家主席习近平计划于9月24日访问美国，双方有望举行新一轮元首会晤。截至目前，中方尚未就具体行程作出正式确认，相关安排仍处于筹备与磋商阶段，具体细节可能随双方沟通进展而调整。
segments.tr: Theo truyền thông nước ngoài, Tổng thống Mỹ Trump gần đây đã phát biểu công khai rằng Chủ tịch Trung Quốc Tập Cận Bình có kế hoạch thăm Hoa Kỳ vào ngày 24 tháng 9, và hai bên kỳ vọng sẽ tổ chức một vòng hội nghị thượng đỉnh nguyên thủ mới. Tính đến thời điểm hiện tại, phía Trung Quốc vẫn chưa chính thức xác nhận hành trình cụ thể, các sắp xếp liên quan vẫn đang trong giai đoạn chuẩn bị và tham vấn, và các chi tiết cụ thể có thể được điều chỉnh theo tiến triển giao tiếp giữa hai bên.

segments.src: 对于长期关注中美关系的观察人士而言，此次传出的访美消息延续了近期两国高层互动趋于活跃的态势，也让外界对下一阶段双边关系走向多了一个观察窗口。

segments.tr: ## Tương tác trước đó: Hội nghị thượng đỉnh Busan và tham vấn Kuala Lumpur

segments.tr: Trước thông tin về chuyến thăm Mỹ lần này, hai bên Trung-Mỹ trước đó đã duy trì liên lạc thông qua nhiều dịp khác nhau. Các báo cáo trước đó đề cập rằng nguyên thủ hai nước từng tổ chức hội nghị thượng đỉnh tại Busan, Hàn Quốc, sau đó đội ngũ công tác của hai bên đã tiến hành nhiều vòng tham vấn tại Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Loạt tương tác này được nhìn nhận phổ biến là nỗ lực liên tục của hai bên nhằm kiểm soát bất đồng và khám phá không gian hợp tác, đồng thời đặt nền tảng giao tiếp cho cuộc gặp cấp cao có thể diễn ra sau đó.
